notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 2.0 IS LIVE !
notes.notes:
[b][/b] MAJOR UPDATE 2.0 IS LIVE !
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32970384/9c6e350fb6d6a5caf0b42c729e7c8f0e6b7be579.png[/img]

We are proud to announce a Major Update for The Life's Lane, which brings new features and improvements to our game and is fully compatible with old save files.   
[list]
[*][b] Introducing Seasons (Summer, Fall, Winter, Spring ) [/b]
         Player will get to experience special Seasonal events, acquire new 
         rewards and deal with new challenges. 
[*][b] New weather effects and animations [/b]
         Each Season has a unique and improved visual identity, with different      
         weather effects that can have positive and negative consequences 
         for the Player. 
[*][b] New EndGame scenario [/b]
         Provides new and old Players with a new EndGame goal. 
[*][b] More Random events [/b]
[*][b] Gameplay balance improvements [/b] 
         Based on player feedback we have considerably reduced the necessary 
         grind required for progress (Up to 50% less grind). We have also made 
          numerous bug fixes and balance improvements.
[/list]

We would like to take this opportunity to give a huge [b]Thank You ![/b] to the community, the feedback has been instrumental in making this update possible. We wish for everyone to enjoy the coming holidays. To celebrate we will be providing large discounts throughout the holiday season !
